The third book in the beloved small-town Chestnut Springs series from the no.1 Sunday Times bestselling author and Queen of Cowboy romance, Elsie Silver.

'No one really does it better than Elsie Silver' THE RADIO TIMES

'Elsie Silver is rapidly becoming one of my favourite romance authors' DAILY MAIL

🏒

"You can wear someone else's ring, but we both know you've always been mine."

To Jasper Gervais's fans, he's just the handsome hockey heartthrob on TV. But to Sloane, he'll always be her childhood best friend - the lost boy with sad eyes and a heart of gold. The man she's loved in secret for years.

So when everything falls apart on the day she's supposed to marry someone else, it only makes sense that he's the one to swoop in and save her. And when his world comes crashing down around him, she's there to return the favour. Desperate for an escape, they set off on an impromptu road trip.

But the more time alone they spend together, the more obvious it becomes that Jasper isn't looking at her like a friend anymore. He isn't touching her like one, either. And after all this time, he's still everything she's ever wanted, everything she thought she could never have.

Their feelings are anything but straightforward. They twist and turn around the pain of his past and the reality of Sloane's present. And after years of turning her away, Jasper might act like he wants her, but he's going to need to prove it.

⭐

READERS ARE POWERLESS TO AN ELSIE SILVER BOOK

'Elsie Silver, Queen of Cowboy' THE TIMES

'Elsie Silver's writing is a true revelation!' ALI HAZELWOOD

'This book contains a hero to die for' TESSA BAILEY

'Heartwarming, sensual and thoroughly addicting' ANA HUANG

'Elsie Silver just hits the mark every time' READER REVIEW

'Each book is heart-wrenching in its own way' READER REVIEW

'The story is so well done that it turned me into a complete cowboy fangirl' READER REVIEW

'These books had me so sucked into the world that I barely looked up' READER REVIEW

*Elsie Silver became an instant Sunday Times bestselling author on the 2nd week of April 2024.
